Senior React Native Developer
Company: Acme Mobile

Acme Mobile builds a fitness tracking app used by 2M people. We are looking for a Senior React Native Developer to own our mobile client.

Location: Remote (Europe time zones)
Salary: $5,000-7,000 per month

Requirements:
- 5+ years of mobile development, 3+ years with React Native
- Strong TypeScript
- Experience with Redux Toolkit or Zustand
- Experience shipping to App Store and Google Play

Nice to have:
- Native modules in Swift or Kotlin
- Firebase, Sentry
- Experience with Expo and EAS Build
